evidence: Pass 10 batch 11: UAT-UI-013. The existing TrustSettings.certificateExpiryPolicy field was not consumed for listing expiry; wired WARN/HOLD_LISTINGS into the atomic certificate lapse transaction. WARN sends a deduplicated expiry notice and removes expired public certification badges while keeping offers active. HOLD_LISTINGS records per-certificate holds only for live offers explicitly linked by SellerListingCertification, sets NEEDS_CHANGES and synchronizes marketplace price projections; unlinked products, rival suppliers and marketplace blocks are preserved. Renewal uses existing seller update and explicit submit plus authorized staff verification routes; it releases only that certificate’s hold, restores our status only when all linked certificates are clear, and preserves later seller pauses or marketplace safety blocks. MariaDB indexed row locks serialize hold/renewal/status operations. Resume checks active holds and unusable linked certificates inside its transaction, preventing pause/resume bypass and activation of already-idle listings. Seller audit entries accompany hold/release; existing certificate system audit/expiry notices remain idempotent. Corrected seven-day warning wording so WARN does not promise listings will be taken off sale.
